title: Fractional porous medium equation on manifolds with nonnegative Ricci curvature: existence of solutions and smoothing effects via potential methods
summary: We study the fractional porous medium equation on complete noncompact Riemannian manifolds with nonnegative Ricci curvature for $s\in(0,1]$ and $n>2s$. Assuming that the manifold is $s$-nonparabolic, so that the fractional Laplacian admits a suitable positive minimal Green function, we use this Green function to introduce a natural weighted space of initial data, strictly larger than $L^1$.
